title: Business & Tech Networking Expo
description: A large mixer bringing together founders, investors, and tech professionals from across the South Bay. Expect lightning intros, an exhibitor floor, and a cash bar.

title: Workshop: Advanced Networking Techniques
description: A hands-on session on building a referral engine for your business — scripts, follow-up cadences, and how to ask for introductions without it feeling awkward.

title: 3-Course Dinner & Networking
description: A seated dinner capped at a small group size so every table actually gets to talk business. Vegetarian option available on request.

title: Online Founders Roundtable
description: A monthly video call for early-stage founders to trade notes on fundraising, hiring, and go-to-market — no pitching, just peer advice.

title: Test
description: Test event submitted through the prototype's event form.
